findings.location: ..."her dear Grandpa was a song leader in their church"...
findings.source_quote: She thought about the fact that her dear Grandpa was a song leader in their church and how much she liked when he led a song.
findings.suggested_fix: Translate wording to avoid implying a formal choir role if the English only says 'song leader'. For example: "dass ihr lieber Opa in ihrer Kirche Lieder anleitete" or "dass ihr lieber Opa in ihrer Kirche Liederdirigent war" only if a choir role is intended. Replace the current phrase in the same paragraph, preserving tags and punctuation.
findings.translation_quote: Sie dachte daran, dass ihr lieber Opa im Kirchenchor Lieder anleitete und wie gern sie es mochte, wenn er ein Lied anleitete.
